trope: 食パンをくわえて遅刻ダッシュ → 曲がり角で転校生とぶつかる
title: 【実写化】食パンくわえて遅刻ダッシュ、現実だとこうなる
hook:
アニメのお約束、
実写でやるとこうなる

cuts.scene: a girl running fast down a quiet Japanese residential street in the morning with a slice of toast in her mouth, school bag swinging
cuts.motion: she sprints toward the camera, hair bouncing, toast in mouth, handheld camera follows

cuts.scene: at a street corner with a concrete wall, a running girl collides with a boy walking around the corner, morning light
cuts.motion: the two bump into each other at the corner and stumble backwards

lines.text: 曲がり角で、運命の出会い……

cuts.scene: a girl and a boy sitting on the asphalt after a collision, a slice of toast lying on the ground between them
a crow on a residential street flying away holding a slice of toast in its beak, girl in the background reaching out in despair
cuts.telop: 現実：パンはカラスのもの

lines.text: 実写だと、だいたいパンが犠牲になる。

caption: アニメのお約束を実写でやってみたシリーズ。次にやってほしいお約束はコメントで！
